title: Solana Foundation Launches Pay.sh in Collaboration with Google Cloud
quote: Payment is the credential - it's that simple. Pay.sh operates as an API proxy built on GCP, sitting in front of Google Cloud services, handling account-less settlement through Solana wallets.

title: pay.sh — pay-as-you-go APIs for AI agents
quote: 72+ active providers. Range: Free to $10.00 per API call. Discovery via llms.txt files, JSON catalogs, and agent skills indexes.

title: solana-foundation/pay: Let your agents pay for any API
quote: pay wraps CLI tools (curl, claude, codex, whoami) to transparently handle 402 Payment Required responses. Rust: 83.9%, TypeScript: 13.5%. Ships with built-in MCP server enabling AI assistants to request paid API calls through local wallet-approval flow. Biometric security via Touch ID (macOS), Windows Hello, GNOME Keyring.

title: solana-foundation/mpp-sdk: Solana payment method for the Machine Payments Protocol
quote: Implements the Solana Charge Intent for the HTTP Payment Authentication Scheme. Multi-language: TypeScript (@solana/mpp), Rust (cargo add solana-mpp), Go, Python, Lua. Rust 39.5%, TypeScript 26.0%, Go 14.8%, Python 11.8%, Lua 6.8%.

title: Introducing the Machine Payments Protocol
quote: Stripe co-authored the Machine Payments Protocol with Tempo and is enabling businesses to accept payments over MPP through their PaymentIntents API with minimal code integration. Announced March 18, 2026.

title: MPP payments — Stripe Documentation
quote: MPP enables internet payments between machines. Servers respond with HTTP 402 containing payment details; after authorization clients receive access with receipts. Supports crypto (stablecoins via deposit addresses) and Shared Payment Token (SPT) for fiat.

title: MPP — Machine Payments Protocol
quote: Open standard for machine-to-machine payments via HTTP 402. Supports stablecoins (Tempo), cards (Stripe), Bitcoin (Lightning), Solana SPL tokens, Stellar SEP-41 tokens, Monad ERC-20, and RedotPay. Multi-method challenges; session-based billing; split payments.

title: Linux Foundation Launches the x402 Foundation
quote: Founding members include: Adyen, Amazon Web Services, American Express, Ampersend.ai, Base, Circle, Cloudflare, Coinbase, Fiserv, Google, KakaoPay, Mastercard, Merit Systems, Microsoft, Polygon Labs, PPRO, Shopify, Sierra, Solana Foundation, Stripe, thirdweb, and Visa. Announced April 2, 2026.

title: Stablecoins enter AI payments as Solana and Google launch Pay.sh
quote: Pay.sh implements two payment standards: x402, an open payment standard that began at Coinbase and later moved under the Linux Foundation, and Machine Payments Protocol developed by Tempo and Stripe. x402 had settled about 165 million transactions across more than 480,000 transacting agents.

title: Solana and Google Cloud Launch Stablecoin Payments Service for AI Agents
quote: Pay.sh launched May 5, 2026. Pay-per-request pricing structure allowing agents to use what they need without subscriptions or minimum spend requirements. Agents pay fractions of a cent per API call.

title: Solana and Google Cloud Launch Pay.sh for AI Agent Payments Using USDC
quote: Solana Foundation CPO Vibhu Norby stated: 'In collaboration with Google Cloud, we're introducing Pay.sh, a gateway service designed to bridge the gap between autonomous agents and enterprise infrastructure.' Over 75 APIs available; payments in USDC.

title: Solana and Google Cloud Roll Out Pay.sh for AI API Access
quote: Pay.sh is built on open standards (x402, MPP) involving players such as Cloudflare, Stripe, Solana Foundation, Coinbase and many others.

title: Stripe-backed crypto startup Tempo releases AI payments protocol, launches blockchain
quote: Stripe and Tempo jointly unveiled the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) on March 18, 2026. Tempo is a blockchain startup incubated by Stripe and venture firm Paradigm, raising $500M at a $5B valuation.

title: Solana Foundation Enters Linux Foundation's x402 Initiative for Web-Native Payments
quote: Solana processes approximately 65% of all x402 transactions. The network settles x402 payments with finality in roughly 400 milliseconds, with typical fees around $0.00025.

title: Overview — pay.sh docs
quote: The system functions as a payment layer for HTTP agents that intercepts requests, detects payment requirements (MPP and x402 challenge types), and facilitates authorization through local wallet integration.

title: tempoxyz/mpp-specs: Specifications for the Machine Payments Protocol
quote: MPP operates as an HTTP Authentication Scheme, formally proposed to the IETF as draft-httpauth-payment-00 (published March 30, 2026, authored by engineers from Tempo Labs and Stripe).

title: HTTP 402 — Wikipedia
quote: HTTP 402 was reserved for future use with the original intention of supporting digital cash or micropayment schemes. It remained unused because no widely-adopted payment protocol emerged.
